Definition
[product of tensors]

Source: petersen:page-0063 ↗ def:pet-ch2-lie-derivative-tensor

For a $(0,k_1)$-tensor $T_1$ and a $(0,k_2)$-tensor $T_2$, their product is the $(0,k_1+k_2)$-tensor \[ (T_1\cdot T_2)(X_1,\dots ,X_{k_1},Y_1,\dots ,Y_{k_2}) =T_1(X_1,\dots ,X_{k_1})\cdot T_2(Y_1,\dots ,Y_{k_2}). \]
